search_text: published ZDI-16-167 ZDI-CAN-3136 Novell Zenworks ChangePassword XPath Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2016-02-11 CVE-2015-5970 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-5970 5.0 ['Novell'] ['Zenworks'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to exfiltrate arbitrary text files on vulnerable installations of Novell Zenworks.
